text: Name an LLM agent or orchestration framework
note: Libraries, SDKs and platforms for building LLM agents, chains or multi-agent systems, plus open-source autonomous agents like AutoGPT

answers.q: Formerly MemGPT: treats the context window like RAM and pages memories in and out. An LLM operating system.
Plans function calls as a DAG and runs them in parallel, the way a compiler would.
Backpropagate natural-language feedback through LLM pipelines as 'textual gradients'.
25 Smallville residents with memories and plans. They organized a Valentine's Day party on their own.
A GPT-4 agent that plays Minecraft and writes itself a growing library of skills as code.
Microsoft's templating language that interleaves generation, control flow and constraints.
A query language for LLMs: prompts with constraints, somewhere between SQL and Python.
Microsoft's generalist team: an Orchestrator directing WebSurfer, FileSurfer, Coder and Terminal agents.
A virtual software company where CEO, CTO, programmer and tester agents chat their way to a product.
An AI user and an AI assistant role-play their way through a task, set up by 'inception prompting'.
Lets an LLM run code on your own machine. A self-hosted Code Interpreter.
ChatGPT as a controller that hands subtasks to models on the Hugging Face Hub.
Microsoft's SDK for C#, Python and Java: plugins, planners and enterprise vibes.
Hugging Face's minimalist agents that act by writing Python code instead of JSON.
OpenAI's 'educational' multi-agent experiment built on handoffs. It grew up into the Agents SDK.
PM, architect and engineer agents following SOPs. Its motto: Code = SOP(Team).
A workflow automation tool that grew AI agent nodes. Low-code and self-hostable.
Formerly OpenDevin: an open platform for software-engineering agents.
'Programming, not prompting.' Write signatures and modules; optimizers compile the prompts for you.
Yohei Nakajima's tiny Python task loop that kicked off the 2023 agent craze alongside AutoGPT.
Chains, agents and a thousand integrations. The framework everyone learned, then complained about.
Born as GPT Index in late 2022: connect your own data to LLMs.
Microsoft's conversable multi-agent framework: agents talk to agents until the job's done.
March 2023's viral 'give GPT-4 a goal and let it loop' agent. Record GitHub stars, then a lot of loops.
